description: Tier-1 <each> per-row if= REACTIVE mount (SPEC §17.1). id=1 seeds on:false (absent at create — comment placeholder), id=2 visible. Clicking #show1 maps @rows flipping id=1's on true; the per-item effect swaps the comment back for the real <li> in place, so Alice's row appears (count 1 -> 2) in her keyed slot (before Bob).
rationale: §17.1 a per-row if= that flips false->true mounts the element. The placeholder comment carried id=1's key, so the swapped-in <li> lands in the correct keyed position (first), proving the comment is a valid tracked node.
